title: A long-term study of young boys with X-linked myotubular myopathy who had previously received ASP2957
official: A Long-term Follow-up Study in Male Participants with X-linked Myotubular Myopathy Treated with ASP2957
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the long-term safety and tolerability of ASP2957
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participant was treated with ASP2957 in a clinical study and has completed, discontinued, or been lost to follow-up from that study.
2. Participant’s parent(s) or legally authorized representative(s) (LAR(s)) has provided informed consent or assent (where applicable) as described in protocol, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the informed consent form (ICF) and protocol.
Exclusion criteria:
1. NA
